description: Java class defining the FileHistory entity for tracking file metadata in an order management system.

classes.name: FileHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing file history records with metadata such as file size, dates, and download count.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the file history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the file history record.

methods.name: getFilesize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: setFilesize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Returns the date when the file was added, cloned for immutability.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the date when the file was added.

methods.name: getDateDeleted
methods.description: Returns the date when the file was deleted, cloned for immutability.

methods.name: setDateDeleted
methods.description: Sets the date when the file was deleted.

methods.name: getAccountedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the file was accounted, cloned for immutability.

methods.name: setAccountedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the file was accounted.
